transcript:
SA: Kvarn Kaffe, det är Sara.
C: Hej! Omar here, from Kafé Solsidan in Malmö. Near Möllan.
SA: Hi Omar! What can I do for you?
C: So we're changing the menu for the winter. Eh, do you have Kenya AA?
SA: Kenya AA... I'll have to check that, I'm not sure.
C: Okay. If you have it, ten kilo of the Kenya. Our regulars keep asking for it.
SA: Ten kilo Kenya AA, if we have it. Anything else?
C: Yes, the normal filter, the Morning Filter. Twenty kilo.
SA: Twenty kilo Morning Filter.
C: Mm. Sorry, someone just dropped a whole tray here... okay. Where was I.
SA: Twenty kilo Morning Filter and the Kenya.
C: Right, that's it. Tjugo kilo filter, and the Kenya if you can.
SA: I'll send you a quote.
C: Tack, hej!

lines.evidence: Tjugo kilo filter, and the Kenya if you can.

reasons: "Kenya AA" is not in our catalog
questions: We don't sell Kenya AA. Would one of our other coffees work?
